summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K on August 18, 2026, announcing the full redemption of its £500,000,000 1.985% Fixed Rate Reset Subordinated Debt Securities due 2031 (ISIN: XS2351166421). The redemption price is 100% of principal plus accrued interest, with the redemption date set for September 15, 2026. The listing on the NYSE will be cancelled on or shortly after that date. This is a routine debt redemption, not a special-situation event like an acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring. It is a standard capital management action by the issuer, with no strategic, governance, or deal-related implications.
